coordinateSystem: Normalized within the entire image; origin top left, x right, y down. Display using contain, then map to the image rectangle, excluding letterboxing.
review: Scene coordinates visually measured from the final day backgrounds. All four phases share the same anchors; minor generated texture differences remain.

aquarium.note: Existing room already includes an aquarium. Use its scene swim rectangle, or replace it with room-aquarium; do not paint a second tank over it.

room.phaseTint: Apply one shared environmental tint to character and prop layers at dusk/night.

stall.keeperOcclusion: After drawing the keeper, redraw the counter rectangle from the same phase background above the lower body.

pond.fishingNote: Left-facing rods should be flipped toward open water; transform foot x as 1-x when flipped. The short line/lure in the sprite is decorative; draw the gameplay line and bobber separately.

renderNotes: Each sprite has its own actual foot anchor. Do not assume canvas center or bottom edge is the contact point.
Use the same world scale for standing, seated and crouching poses; do not stretch shorter poses to standing height.
Use plant roots at plantingPoint; plot soil is already drawn in outdoor-field and must not be duplicated.
Fade background phases over a few seconds. Main object placement is visually consistent; generated relighting is not pixel-identical.
Room object positions are suggested placements and require integration review against the existing furniture.
